HOW TALANTATIX WORKS

1. Register

Create your free account with your name, email, phone and country in under a minute.

2. Choose tickets

Pick Regular, VIP or VVIP and the number of seats — prices update live from the box office.

3. Pay with M-Pesa

An STK push is sent to your phone via TinyPesa. Enter your PIN to pay securely.

4. Scan & enter

Your QR e-ticket is issued instantly after confirmation. Scan at the gate and enjoy the game!
